seen.cipher: Galende Díaz 2000, p. 66 n. 52 (read in full here) says that captain-general José Cienfuegos proposed in 1817 a cipher that replaces the vowels by digits (A=5, E=3, I=1, O=2, U=4) with consonants unchanged, and cites 'el criptograma que remite desde La Habana, el 25 de mayo de 1819, al marqués de Casa-Irujo. Archivo General de Indias, Estado, 12, documento 14' as an example. Whether a decipherment is on or with the leaf could not be checked.
